provenance: DONUT-PROG-01 DP-A (docs/03-tech/donut-prog-01-floor01-ability-progression.md, DP-Q13..DP-Q34, DP-Q45, DP-Q46). Every knob of the two Floor 01 capabilities of the second hero, named by its question ID: the passive jump boost (a launch value that replaces the base launch while held) and the short horizontal blink (range, cost, cooldown, timeline, search insets, presentation counts). Adopted defaults under the owner's design-defaults directive, not approved balance. DP-A only loads, validates and pins the values; DP-B (the launch), DP-C (the blink) and DP-D (presentation) read them. The companion-AI knobs of DP-Q37..DP-Q41 live in companion_ai_v0.json (DP-E, a recorded schema extension).
